policy: Rockstar-published pre-release promotional information only. Never include leaks, unreleased plot revelations, alleged endings or speculation.

items.title: The central story
items.summary: Jason and Lucia become caught up in a criminal conspiracy spreading across Leonida after a seemingly straightforward job goes wrong. Rockstar presents their partnership and dependence on one another as the heart of the story.

items.title: Jason Duval
items.summary: Jason grew up among hustlers and criminals. He joined the Army hoping to leave his troubled teenage years behind, then ended up working with drug runners in the Leonida Keys. Meeting Lucia may change the direction of his life.

items.title: Lucia Caminos
items.summary: Lucia learned to fight from her father at an early age. Protecting her family led to imprisonment at Leonida Penitentiary. Now released, she wants the better life her mother imagined back when they lived in Liberty City.

items.title: Cal Hampton
items.summary: Cal is Jason's friend and one of Brian Heder's associates. He prefers monitoring Coast Guard communications and internet conspiracies from the safety of home.

items.title: Boobie Ike
items.summary: A figure in Vice City's street and business worlds, Boobie has interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio. He is working with Dre'Quan Priest to build the Only Raw Records label.

items.title: Dre'Quan Priest
items.summary: Dre'Quan wants success in music rather than a permanent life on the streets. He's involved with Only Raw Records and has brought the rap duo Real Dimez onto the label.

items.title: Real Dimez
items.summary: Longtime friends Bae-Luxe and Roxy use rap, social media and an established local following to push their careers. They are now signed to Only Raw Records.

items.title: Raul Bautista
items.summary: Raul is an experienced bank robber who seeks talented partners for high-stakes scores. His willingness to take risks creates pressure for the crews he recruits.

items.title: Brian Heder
items.summary: Brian is a veteran drug runner operating out of his Keys boat yard. He lets Jason stay at one of his properties in exchange for helping with local jobs and favours.

items.title: Vice City
items.summary: Leonida's neon-lit metropolitan centre is a major backdrop to the game. Rockstar has published dedicated city imagery and video material.

items.title: Leonida Keys
items.summary: A chain of islands within Leonida. Rockstar has established the Keys as the base of Jason's recent work and several contacts.

items.title: Grassrivers
items.summary: One of the six prominently featured areas of Leonida in Rockstar's official People & Places material.

items.title: Port Gellhorn
items.summary: Another officially introduced region of Leonida, featured separately within Rockstar's locations showcase.

items.title: Ambrosia
items.summary: A named region revealed through Rockstar's official Leonida location material.

items.title: Mount Kalaga
items.summary: Rockstar's official material introduces Mount Kalaga as one of the state's explorable destinations.

items.title: Radio and podcasts
items.summary: Rockstar has confirmed more in-game radio, six previewed stations and on-demand podcasts. Compatible in-game headphones and earbuds allow listening beyond vehicles.

items.title: Original score by Justice
items.summary: Justice composed the adaptive original score. Rockstar says the album contains 30 tracks and is scheduled for 11 December 2026.

items.title: Console presentation
items.summary: Rockstar says the game targets 30 frames per second on supported current-generation consoles, while PlayStation 5 Pro adds PSSR enhancements and ray-traced shadows.

items.title: Editions and bonuses
items.summary: Rockstar has detailed a standard pre-order, an Ultimate Edition and a Vintage Vice City Pack for eligible early purchasers. For full inclusions, consult the official editions page.
